theorems.name: Submission.bv_euclideanDivergence_convolution
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), LocallyIntegrable κ volume → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∀ x, Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (convolution κ g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x = convolution κ (Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x
